newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Thierry Daman said that the Commission, during its weekly meeting, had approved a green paper on education, training and research, an action plan on learning in the information society, aids to employment in Wallonia and a global framework for actions in urban underprivileged neighbourhoods.

The Commission also outlined a set of principles for future contractual relations with certain countries in South East Europe, proposed a second phase of textiles liberalisation under GATT, authorised tax deduction scheme for ships operated under the German flag, it declared that financing of Portuguese public television was not to be considered as state aid but initiated state aid procedures against measures in the milk sector in Sardinia as well as the textiles sector in France, Daman said.
He also announced a technical briefing at 1500/1300 GMT in the press room on textiles liberalisation under GATT.

Spokeswoman Sarah Lambert briefed on the Transport Council that will take place on Thursday and Friday. She said the three main issues were transport negotiations with Switzerland, Eurovignette negotiations and the white paper on European railways.
In answer to a question, spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said progress had been made in negotiations on parnership with Jordan, notably in the field of agriculture.
Coll i Cabro also announced a cooperation Council with Egypt on October 28.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/870: Commission proposes second phase of textiles liberalisation under GATT.
- IP/96/873: Western Sahara refugees in Algeria: Commission approves humanitarian aid package worth ECU 6.45 million.
- IP/96/874: Commission authorises depreciation/tax deduction scheme for ships operating under the German flag.
- IP/96/877: Commission in bid to speed up schools' espousal of the information society.
- IP/96/878: Education, training, research, eliminate obstacles to mobility.
- IP/96/879: State aids: France, Commission seeks further explanations on textiles plan.
- IP/96/880: State aid, Commission approves aid for recruitment of unemployed in Wallonia.
- IP/96/881: Urban underprivileged neighbourhoods: Commission offers framework for actions in member states.
- Speech/96/232: Speech by Commissioner Flynn on European works councils and the Europeanisation of industrial relations.
- Eurostat news release No 64/96: EU annual inflation: new record low.
- Learning in the information society: action plan for a European education society.
- Preliminary draft green paper on education - training - research, the obstacles to transnational mobility.
- ME96/2.10: Midday express.
